name: AI-Aided Design and Drawing — owned CAD domain template
scope: Language-first CAD/BIM and drawing generation interactions, deterministic validation, source-linked levels, disciplines, detailed views and exports

architecture.reusable_interface: Other AI interpreters normalize to locally validated source-backed requests; A7 only resolves the owner
architecture.directory_rule: Never write, update, publish, or auto-sync A7 from CAD tasks; proposals may be recorded in CAD repo pending explicit user authorization

pipeline.stage: Natural language, dimensions, revisions, photo or verified drawing reference; user never manually composes JSON
Read source authority; extract evidence-backed intent; identify missing facts
Source rev/hash, quantities and units, stable IDs, constraints, private/public authorization
IfC/OpenCascade/ezdxf/Three.js deterministic geometry from normalized source
Native geometry, reproducible output manifests, regression tests, separate licensed engineer acceptance
3D-first building -> level -> discipline -> component -> drawing section -> work detail, role-based labels and color legend
Canonical request hash, source version/hash, engine commit, dependency locks, output digest and approval status

display.3D: Semantic selection, isolated layers, element dimensions and role-filtered instructions
display.4D: Cross-repo referenced Scheduling tasks, dependencies and milestones; not owned by A7/CAD
display.5D: Cross-repo referenced Cost QTO/rate/BOQ under Cost ownership; not owned by A7/CAD
display.worker_gate: Approved issued-for-construction revision required before treating graphics as work instructions

controls.reproducibility: Same canonical normalized request, immutable source bytes, pinned engine/toolchain, stable settings and output manifest, not merely same prose prompt

supersedes_external_ownership_assumption: A7 policy file policies/global/ai-aided-product-guide.v0.1.json is a preexisting historical placement, NOT canonical for AAD domain. Do not mutate or delete it without separate explicit A7 instructions.
